inputs.name: character
examples: the armored swordswoman from the reference image

descriptions.en: One-line character description matching the uploaded reference image
descriptions.zh-CN: 要转换的角色一句话（与上传参考图一致）

inputs.name: combat_style
inputs.default: Follow the character's original combat logic if any; otherwise melee weapons drive weapon strikes, ranged weapons drive shots or projectiles, elemental/magic/energy abilities get matching effect visuals, and absent all of these use a natural physical melee attack.

descriptions.en: Combat action design; the template derives it from the character when left as the default
descriptions.zh-CN: 战斗动作设计说明；留空则由模板自动按角色推导

inputs.name: reference_binding
examples: the uploaded character reference image attached at generation time

descriptions.en: How the reference image is attached; or 'no reference image, design from description'
descriptions.zh-CN: 参考图如何附加的说明；无参考图时写 no reference image, design from description
